title: Synthetic golden-prober for composed-request latency provenance and progressive-shed workbench
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a synthetic 'golden' prober that emits composed requests which exercise routing, KV prefetch, kernel-selection, and decode stages, capturing per-stage latency provenance and a stable traceable id. Instrument the prober so each emitted span includes: origin region, chosen model variant, admit decision, KV hit/miss, batch id, and circuit decision metadata. The prober must feed a new telemetry stream that supports: short-time-window quantiles, cohorting by sequence-length bucket, and per-tenant admit-score correlation. The goal is twofold: 1) power a new dashboard that lets SRE and runtime engineers explore why individual requests hit circuit boundaries and what upstream decisions contributed to tail latency; 2) provide a progressive-shed simulator on the dashboard to replay different circuit thresholds and visualize downstream regional spillover and estimated token-cost delta.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic prober service deployed to staging and can replay configurable prefixes/sequence-length distributions
Telemetry stream includes per-stage timing fields (routing, kv_prefetch, kernel_sched, decode) and a stable trace_id propagated across services
Grafana dashboard with: request provenance waterfall panel, per-stage quantiles, admit-score heatmap, and progressive-shed slider that simulates threshold changes
Simulator can run a 1h synthetic replay and output estimated regional failover counts and token-cost change report
Runbook describing how to add new composed probes and how to interpret waterfall traces
comments: 2026-03-01 — Kickoff: scoped MVP. Decided to reuse the synthetic traffic harness from ENG-48888 for load shaping but extend payload composition to include KV prefetch semantics.
2026-03-04 — Design review: PM + SRE feedback: add admit-score correlation and tenant-tagging to allow per-customer impact analysis. Action: add tenant sampling to prober config.
2026-03-07 — Eng update: implemented per-span envelope and trace_id propagation in the runtime-side SDK. Initial telemetry proof-of-concept pushed to staging ingestion cluster.
2026-03-10 — UX review: Dashboard wireframe approved. Grafana team will implement waterfall using stacked bar with hover drilldowns. Need sample queries for pre-aggregation.
2026-03-12 — QA: ran 30m replay with 10k composed requests; discovered KV-prefetch emits inconsistent metrics when batch sizes > 16. Filed followup ENG-777778 to investigate batching artifact.
2026-03-14 — Status: migrating prober to canary group in us-west-2. Dashboard panels partially implemented; simulator backend needs endpoint for historical replay which infra is provisioning.
decision_log: Keep prober as a separate service behind feature-flag to avoid noise for low-traffic customers
Use pre-aggregated quantiles (tdigest) for per-stage 50/90/99 to reduce storage and query cost
Simulator will be read-only against a replay index to avoid perturbing production metrics
followups: ENG-777778 — investigate KV-prefetch metric skew when batches exceed size 16
ENG-777779 — integrate prober trace_id into Sentry alerts for traced failures
PM-1212 — prioritize dashboard onboarding docs and SRE runbook updates
